components.shield.criticalDescription.defaultMessage: This rating is given to flaws that could be easily exploited by a remote unauthenticated attacker and lead to system compromise (arbitrary code execution) without requiring user interaction. These are the types of vulnerabilities that can be exploited by worms. Flaws that require an authenticated remote user, a local user, or an unlikely configuration are not classed as Critical impact.
components.shield.criticalDescription.description: Security impact shield tooltip explaining the Critical vulnerability rating and its exploitability criteria.

components.shield.importantDescription.defaultMessage: This rating is given to flaws that can easily compromise the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of resources. These are the types of vulnerabilities that allow local users to gain privileges, allow unauthenticated remote users to view resources that should otherwise be protected by authentication, allow authenticated remote users to execute arbitrary code, or allow remote users to cause a denial of service.
components.shield.importantDescription.description: Security impact shield tooltip explaining the Important vulnerability rating and consequences for confidentiality, integrity or availability.

components.shield.lowDescription.defaultMessage: This rating is given to all other issues that have a security impact. These are the types of vulnerabilities that are believed to require unlikely circumstances to be able to be exploited, or where a successful exploit would give minimal consequences.
components.shield.lowDescription.description: Security impact shield tooltip explaining the Low vulnerability rating and limited exploitability or consequences.

components.shield.moderateDescription.defaultMessage: This rating is given to flaws that may be more difficult to exploit but could still lead to some compromise of the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of resources, under certain circumstances. These are the types of vulnerabilities that could have had a Critical impact or Important impact but are less easily exploited based on a technical evaluation of the flaw, or affect unlikely configurations.
components.shield.moderateDescription.description: Security impact shield tooltip explaining the Moderate vulnerability rating compared with Critical and Important ratings.

components.shield.unknownDescription.defaultMessage: Red Hat Product Security has determined that this vulnerability does not impact Red Hat products.
components.shield.unknownDescription.description: Security impact shield tooltip for the Unknown rating; current source explains that Red Hat products are not affected. Confirm the rating-to-explanation pairing during review.
